GitHub issue #1015 nested-expression reproducer; the original accepts because crep_to_loop flattens nested Word expressions into Loop temporaries, while the port's Word-to-Stack lowering exhausted its fixed four-register temporary pool before the pool-expansion fix recorded by flapjack-pxn.2.5. The residual byte/layout difference is the remaining tracked gap.

Deepened GitHub issue #1015 variant (one extra addition level, six live nested temporaries); the original accepts, and after the pool-expansion fix flapjack-pxn.2.5 the port accepts too. Recorded to show the fix generalizes past the four-register reserved pool.

GitHub issue #1015 previously-failing left-associative subtraction chain (five nested binary nodes); the original accepts and the port accepts after the flapjack-pxn.2.5 pool-expansion fix, extending coverage of the temporary-pool floor beyond the addition variants.
GitHub issue #1020 reproducer: CakeML riscv_ast Const lowering for 0x40000008 uses LUI+ADDI; the port now materializes all bits but still has an allocator-induced result-register copy.

Differential-fuzzing finding dup-global (GitHub issue #962 smoke): CakeML accepts a duplicate top-level global with the warning 'variable g is redeclared in top-level declaration' and keeps the later declaration; Flapjack previously rejected it in staticCheckDecls. Tracked by flapjack-pxn.8.5.14.4.

Differential-fuzzing finding nomain-global (GitHub issue #962 smoke): the original CakeML pan_to_target synthesizes a main returning zero when the source has none, so a main-less program is accepted; Flapjack previously failed with 'entry not found'. Fixed by panTargetDeclarationsWithDefaultMain. Tracked by flapjack-pxn.8.5.14.3.

Multi-function callee argument/return ABI (GitHub issue #1024 / flapjack-pxn.8.5.10.1.1): the original CakeML passes value argument j in hardware riscv_names (j+1) with the incoming link in hardware 1, so the callee body is minimal (add a0,a1,a0; ret). Flapjack now emits the correct parallel entry moves but still keeps a redundant link-register move and does not coalesce parameters onto the ABI registers.

Relational-condition lowering (GitHub issue #1027 / flapjack-pxn.8.5.14.11): the original CakeML emitter branches directly on the negated comparison against the argument register with the then-branch as the fall-through path (addi a1,x0,10; bge a0,a1,+12; addi a0,x0,1; ret; addi a0,x0,0; ret), so no boolean is materialized and no extra jump is emitted; the port currently negates and swaps branches in Lab.labFlatten with an extra unconditional jump.

hello.pnk whole-artifact parity (GitHub issue #1022 / bead flapjack-8tb): runtime sections cml__Init_0..cml__StoreConsts_5 and cml_generated_main_6 are byte-identical between the original and the port, and only cml_main differs (Cake 152 bytes versus Flapjack 204 bytes). The port keeps the incoming link-register copy and uncoalesced parallel-move copies, uses a direct JumpLower to the halt section for the frame-overflow check instead of the original inline halt form, and materialises the result through a shared return variable.
